mapper.insert: INSERT INTO eval_case (platform, bot_id, group_id, case_type, scenario, rubric, rubric_version, origin, trace_ref, input_digest, output_digest, status) VALUES (#{platform}, #{botId}, #{groupId}, #{caseType}, #{scenario}, #{rubric}, #{rubricVersion}, #{origin}, #{traceRef}, #{inputDigest}, #{outputDigest}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT id, platform AS platform, bot_id AS botId, group_id AS groupId, case_type AS caseType, scenario, rubric, rubric_version AS rubricVersion, origin, trace_ref AS traceRef, input_digest AS inputDigest, output_digest AS outputDigest, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM eval_case WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE eval_case SET case_type = #{caseType}, scenario = #{scenario}, rubric = #{rubric}, rubric_version = #{rubricVersion}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
